format: JavaScript (ES6 module with LightningJS Blits framework)
description: This file defines a 'NotesList' component for a LightningJS application, responsible for rendering a list of notes with search, create, delete, and selection functionalities. It includes properties, computed values, methods for interaction, and a template for UI layout.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A LightningJS component for displaying and managing a list of notes, including search, selection, creation, and deletion functionalities.

methods.name: $relativeTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp as a relative time string (e.g., '5m ago', '2h ago').

methods.name: $moveDown
methods.description: Moves the selection down in the list and triggers the onSelect callback with the new selected item's ID.

methods.name: $moveUp
methods.description: Moves the selection up in the list and triggers the onSelect callback with the new selected item's ID.

methods.name: $selectItem
methods.description: Selects the current item based on internal index and triggers the onSelect callback.

methods.name: $handleCreate
methods.description: Invokes the onCreate callback to create a new note and resets internal index.

methods.name: $deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected item by invoking the onDelete callback.
